html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

An unknown virus has spread across the globe, 
turning countless citizens and Super Heroes into zombies 
and throwing the world into chaos!

 

In this Update Details, we are introducing the September Update,
featuring the Marvel Animation’s Marvel Zombies inspired theme.

 

New Uniforms have been added for Shang-Chi, Ms. Marvel (Kamala Khan), 
Captain Marvel, and Scarlet Witch, who are now in conflict with each other,
some having survived the chaos as humans, others having turned into zombies.

 

Tier-4 advancement has been added for Shang-Chi, 
a master of kung-fu known for his diverse martial arts skills, 
and Ms. Marvel (Kamala Khan), a Super Hero fan with a strong sense of justice.

 

Additionally, the Zombie Survival content, 
where you must fight off waves of zombies and survive until the end, 
has been newly revamped.

 

Other improvements to make the game more enjoyable have been added as well, 
so please check the details below!

 

 

▣ Four New Uniforms

 

To celebrate the Marvel Animation’s Marvel Zombies inspired update, four new Uniforms have been added.
Check out the abilities of Shang-Chi <Marvel Animation’s Marvel Zombies>, 
Ms. Marvel (Kamala Khan) <Marvel Animation’s Marvel Zombies>, 
Captain Marvel <Marvel Animation’s Marvel Zombies>, 
and Scarlet Witch <Marvel Animation’s Marvel Zombies>.  
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The four new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <September Update Celebration Event> 
and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 

 


▣ Shang-Chi & Ms. Marvel (Kamala Khan) Tier-4

 

Tier-4 advancement has been added for Shang-Chi, who stands his ground and fights against the endless threats of villains, and Ms. Marvel (Kamala Khan), who started with a deep admiration for Super Heroes and ultimately fulfilled her dream.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 


▣ Warwolf, Gorilla-Man, and Slapstick Potential Awakening & Transcendence


Warwolf, Gorilla-Man, Slapstick will acquire
Potential Awakening & Transcendence through the September Update!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Zombie Survival Improvements

 

Zombie Survival, a mode where you survive by defeating waves of zombies for a set amount of time, has been revamped to provide a new and exciting experience for all our Agents.

 

 

1. The clear condition for Zombie Survival has been changed.
- Before: Defeat the boss zombie and have at least 1 hero survive until the final time limit.
- After: At least 1 hero must survive until the final time limit

 

2. The difficulty levels have been simplified.
- Before: Up to 100 levels
- After: Up to 10 levels
* Due to the difficulty level adjustment, all previous records will be reset.

 

3. The skill restriction has been changed.
- Before: Up to 3 skills could be restricted.
- After: Up to 2 skills can be restricted.

 

4. An Auto-Repeat function has been added.
- Using this feature will consume Clear Tickets.

 

 

5. The Corrosive Gas has been removed from the list of stage hazards.

 

6. Zombie Gas will now appear in all Zombie Survival stages.
- Zombie Gas appears when the number of zombies in a stage reaches a certain count. 
The higher the number of zombies, the more damage the gas inflicts.

 

7. The condition for the required number of surviving heroes in some challenges has been changed.

 

8. Three new Zombie Survival bosses have been added.
- Scarlet Witch / Captain Marvel / Wong

 

9. As previously announced, Zombie Survival, which was temporarily suspended from 9/20 (Sat) to 9/24 (Wed), will be available to play again after the update. Due to the rank reset, the rank rewards for that week will not be distributed. Instead, all Agents will receive the weekly 1st place reward through inbox.
- 4,000,000 Gold
- Eternal Flame x1,100
- Zombie Survival Token x1,000

 

Please check the link below for related information and distribution details.
Go to → [Pre-notice of Temporary Suspension of Zombie Survival Content]

 


▣ New Artifacts

 

After the September Update, Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for 
Warwolf, Gorilla-Man and Slapstick will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 


▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 


- The Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased. 
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. 
Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, 
one as an Otherworld Battle reward, and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[September Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection


Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Marvel Animation’s Marvel Zombies.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

 

▣ Update Hot Deal Products

 

1.  Update Hot Deal products have been added.
- Event Schedule: 
After the 9/23 Maintenance - 10/21 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 9/23 Maintenance - 10/21 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- Find various update celebration products like Hot Deal! 100M Gold Pack, and Hot Deal! Custom Gear Unequip Pack in the Hot Deals category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Inventory: The maximum number of items that can be mass-selected for conversion and sale has been increased from 24 to 50.

 

2. Awakened ISO-8: You can now use Boost ISO-8 as a material to change options.

 

3. World Boss: The "clear boss with specific heroes" condition for unlock challenges has been eased.
- Before: The count only increased when the specific hero was included in the participating heroes (3 members).
- After: The count will now increase if the specific hero is included in either the participating heroes (3 members) or the ally heroes (5 members).

 

4. Timeline Battle: When entering the content, the last team you used will be pre-selected on the screen.
* If you don't have a previously selected team or if you have reinstalled the game, Team 1 will be selected.

 

5. Giant Boss Raid: A new speech bubble has been added to make it easier to notice when a co-op skill has been used successfully.

 

6. Ghost Rider <Savage Avengers>: When the graphic quality is set to Very Low, the spider effect that appears when using the 'Sin Devourer' skill has been changed to a different effect.

 

7. The name of Hellstorm <TVA> uniform has been changed for specific languages.

 

[9/24 (Wed) 10:17 (UTC+0), 9/24 (Wed) 3:17 (PDT) added]

8. Collector's Chest Ticket has been added.

- This item can be consistently acquired at a set probability upon clearing Dispatch Missions (using energy) and Dimmension Missions.

- It's an item that can be used during an event period, and usage details will be announced later through an event notice.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes


1. Alliance Battle: Fixed an issue where some parts of heroes' appearances were not displaying correctly during gameplay.

 


We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
